verdict.rationale: Vercel documents built-in observability to "monitor traffic, function performance, and errors" and an in-browser toolbar to "inspect performance". Visitor behavior (visitors, page views, custom events) is evidenced only through the Vercel MCP `get_web_analytics` tool rather than a dedicated analytics product page, so the visitor-behavior half is thinly documented. missing for 10: dedicated first-party Web Analytics docs (dashboards, retention, filtering), real-user/Core Web Vitals performance tracking documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics

citations.quote: Monitor traffic, function performance, and errors with framework-aware insights across your apps and AI workflows.
`get_web_analytics` ("query visitors, page views, and custom events")
An in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage flags, preview drafts, and inspect performance.
Learn how to emit application-specific metrics from Vercel Functions and analyze them in Observability.
